facts.text: Research College of Nursing offers an HCA Midwest Health Work Loan Forgiveness program that covers $30,375 of tuition in exchange for a two-year commitment to work as a registered nurse at an HCA facility after graduation.

sources.title: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) | Research College of Nursing
sources.quote: The HCA Midwest Health Work Loan Forgiveness program covers a significant portion of your tuition. This exclusive agreement trades tuition support for a two-year commitment to work as an RN at an HCA facility
